items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-08-06
items.q: from Culver City came bands like Lionel Hampton and Les Hype.

ctx.x: What about on the West Coast?

Another big mistake was not going to the West Coast. I was offered a contract at the Culver City. Cotton Club in Culver City. And I didn't want to go West. I thought maybe New York would have a bigger effect on my music career. That's a mistake because from Culver City came bands like Lionel Hampton and Les Hype. Bands like that, you see. Well, I could have gone to California and possibly made greater strides than going to New York. But I don't know. It might have amounted to the same thing. Not having enough…
